newsitem.title: USA: Hilton Hotels sets $325 mln in 7-yr debt.
newsitem.headline: Hilton Hotels sets $325 mln in 7-yr debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from Hilton Hotels Corp was priced on Thursday via joint lead managers Merrill Lynch & Co, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities and JP Morgan Securities, dealer said.
TYPE NOTES ISS PRICE 99.757 FIRST PAY DATE
LAST MOODY'S Baa1 YIELD 7.045 PAY FREQ SEMI
LAST S&P BBB-plus SPREAD +90 BP CALLABLE NO
Market sources said Hilton's offering carries a reset provision, which in the event of a downgrade to non-investment grade status, would require the coupon on the issue to be reset as follows:
B1 or below B-plus or below +300
The coupon reset provision covers a three-year period, source added.
However, analysts said the provision is likely to go unused as such a downgrade would be extremely unlikely given Hilton's deep commitment to investment grade ratings.
Proceeds from the offering are expected to be used to repay a portion of borrowings under the firm's commercial paper program, sources said.
